title: Autonomous forward work boundary
summary: Current Zonoid autonomy is autonomous dispatch plus gated planning/merge: ready tasks can be picked by active or managed heartbeat loops, Subconscious prepares isolated assignments, workers complete/judges review, and self_plan makes next_action return plan when drained. The daemon still needs a driver to consume plan/spawn actions, and feature/main merges plus structured approval gates remain explicit decisions rather than fully automatic.
